correctness.rationale: For every s>=3, a vanishing linear combination of edge indicators on all trees has every coefficient zero: use tree exchanges across a cut and fixed tree size. Induct on n for a vanishing pair sum: attach reserved vertex n by different leaf edges to force mixed coefficients equal via linear uniqueness; restrict to old trees to determine old pairs; use full star and one-old-edge near-star evaluations to eliminate common mixed weights; omit two star edges and connect omitted vertices via old edges to eliminate remaining pairs. Base n=3 incidence matrix is identity. Fixed tree-size relation reduces constants and singleton indicators to pairs, yielding m+1 independent relations. Exact independent enumeration of Prüfer trees/linear algebra confirmed n=3,4,5 pair ranks 3,15,45; no finite extrapolation.
